Definition: properly, the waist or small of the back; only in plural the loins
BiblicalUsage: Mothen is the loins, the waist — Israel eats the Passover with loins girded, shoes on feet and staff in hand, righteousness is the girdle of the Messiah's loins, and Elijah girds up his loins and runs before Ahab to Jezreel.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe girded loins are the Bible's picture of readiness: truth round the waist, and feet ready to move when God says go.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
